-- Park & Shop
UPDATE projects 
SET seoKeywords = 'scenic design, Park and Shop, dystopian, Okoboji Summer Theatre, industrial, site-specific'
WHERE slug = 'park-shop';

INSERT IGNORE INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id 
FROM projects p
CROSS JOIN tags t
WHERE p.slug = 'park-shop'
AND t.name IN ('Dystopian', 'Industrial', 'Contemporary Drama', 'Summer Stock', '2024');

-- Southside Bethel Baptist Church
UPDATE projects

INSERT IGNORE INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id 
FROM projects p

WHERE p.slug = 'southside-bethel-baptist-church'
